findings.description: A call to subprocess.run uses a hardcoded list of arguments, which prevents any command injection vulnerabilities.

                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-sS",
                    "-c",
                    "import platform; print(platform.mac_ver()[0])",
                ],
                check=True,

                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
            ).stdout
